svg.title: SLAP2 glutamate signal quality by processing cohort
svg.desc: A shows one raw glutamate trace with detected events and one event-amplitude measurement; B the source footprint; C and D the DMD1 and DMD2 dendritic maps of the example session, with each source colored by its median event amplitude. E shows the cumulative distribution of median event amplitude across 2,521 sources from 20 sessions, with a noise-only reference; F the DMD1 and DMD2 pools; G each session. E, F and G separate the glutamate-only and glutamate-plus-calcium cohorts.
